name: Basic SPOM
description: Self-Powered Oxygen Machine. Electrolyzer splits water into O2 and H2. Hydrogen generator consumes H2 to power the electrolyzer. Net power positive. Requires water input and gas management.

buildings.note: Center of build. Consumes 1kg/s water, produces O2 + H2.
Burns H2 to produce 800W. Powers electrolyzer (120W) with surplus.
Pumps O2 out of electrolyzer chamber into base.
Pumps H2 from electrolyzer chamber to hydrogen generator.
Filters H2 to generator loop; O2 passes to base. Required to separate gases.
Pumps water into electrolyzer. Must be submerged in water source.
Floor tile — seal electrolyzer chamber bottom.
Pipe H2 from electrolyzer area to gas filter.
Pipe H2 from filter to hydrogen generator.
Pipe O2 out from electrolyzer chamber.
Water pipe from liquid pump into electrolyzer.
Conductive wire — generator output to electrolyzer and pumps.

dig_first.note: Clear space for build area — 8 wide x 6 tall

prerequisites.description: Unlocks Electrolyzer. Must be researched before build can start.
Water source must be accessible near build site for liquid pump.

notes: Gas management is critical — electrolyzer room must be sealed or gases will mix and stall.
Hydrogen generator produces 800W; electrolyzer consumes 120W; two gas pumps consume 240W total. Net ~440W surplus.
Place in or near a water biome, or adjacent to a water reservoir.
Overpressure will stall electrolyzer if gas pressure exceeds 2kg in the room — ensure pumps are operational first.
This is the minimum viable SPOM. Larger variants use aquatuners for cooling or multiple electrolyzers.
